title: Technology Sector Update for 08/22/2018: PSTG,KEYS,SMCI
text:

Technology stocks were moderately higher in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 were adding nearly 0.3% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was climbing almost 0.5%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Pure Storage ( PSTG ) raced to a new record high on Wednesday, climbing 19.5% to a best-ever $26.30 a share after reporting a surprise non-GAAP profit of $0.01 per share during the May-to-July fiscal period, beating the Capital IQ consenus expecting a $0.06 per share adjusted net loss as net sales grew 37% year-over-year and also topping analyst projections. Pure Storage late Tuesday also said it acquired StorReduce earlier in August for an undisclosed amount, with the deal for the deduplication technology company adding cloud-optimized data reduction software capacity to its flash and object storage portfolio. Analysts at least three brokerages responded by raising their price targets for the company's stock, including a $5 increase to $29 a share at Lake Street and a $1 rise to $30 a share at BMO Capital Markets while Oppenheimer boosted its price target for Pure Storage to $26 a share and added the stock to its Top Picks list.
In other sector news:
+ Keysight Technologies ( KEYS ) reached a new record high on Wednesday, climbing more than 16%, after reporting fiscal Q3 financial results exceeding Wall Street forecasts. Excluding one-time items, the company earned $0.89 per share after revenue rose 17% over year-ago levels to $1.02 billion. Analysts, on average, had been expecting $0.79 per share on $962 million in revenue.
- Super Micro Computer ( SMCI ) fell to its lowest share price since October 2013 after saying it will likely miss an August 24 deadline to file its Form 10-K annual report for the 12 months ended June 30, 2017, along with its subsequent quarterly reports and is expecting the Nasdaq stock market to soon begin proceedings to delist the company's stock.
